axes.label: MAGA
axes.definition: Make America Great Again movement: America-first rhetoric, Trump loyalty, anti-establishment posture, border/immigration hard line.

axes.label: America First
axes.definition: Non-interventionist or nationalist foreign policy, tariffs, reduced alliances, domestic-industry priority.

axes.label: Trump
axes.definition: Personal/political alignment with Donald Trump: endorsements, staff, votes to shield or advance his agenda.

axes.label: Tea Party
axes.definition: How much you want that 2009–14 spending/debt, TARP-backlash tradition (Freedom Caucus lineage).

axes.label: Ron Paul movement
axes.definition: Ron Paul movement: audit the Fed, non-intervention, hard money, 2008/2012 GOP insurgency.

axes.label: Occupy Wall Street
axes.definition: How much you want that 99%/anti-bank, debt-and-foreclosure protest tradition.

axes.label: AOC
axes.definition: How much you want Squad / Justice Democrat insurgency vs party leadership.

axes.label: Populist
axes.definition: Anti-elite, anti-institution rhetoric from either left or right.

axes.label: Libertarian
axes.definition: Small government, civil liberties, non-intervention, drug/speech decriminalization.

axes.label: Communism
axes.definition: Explicit communist program, party membership, or nationalization of major industries. Not 'voted for a tax'.

axes.label: Socialism
axes.definition: Democratic-socialist program: DSA, public ownership, Medicare for All as single-payer, wealth cap.

axes.label: Green New Deal
axes.definition: GND-style climate industrial policy, fossil phase-out, job guarantee tied to decarbonization.

axes.label: Classical liberal
axes.definition: How much you want free speech, markets, limited government, civil liberties (often vs progressive identitarianism).

axes.label: NeoCon
axes.definition: How much you want interventionist foreign policy, democracy-promotion wars, strong NATO/Ukraine aid.

axes.label: Zionist
axes.definition: Pro-Israel policy alignment (AIPAC/CUFI, aid votes, statements). Not ethnicity or religion.

axes.label: FDR-era
axes.definition: How much you want this era's policy mix. New Deal: Social Security, public works, wartime industry.

axes.label: JFK-era
axes.definition: How much you want this era's policy mix. Cold War liberal: tax cuts, anti-communism, New Frontier.

axes.label: LBJ-era
axes.definition: How much you want this era's policy mix. Great Society: Medicare, Voting Rights, War on Poverty.

axes.label: Nixon-era
axes.definition: How much you want this era's policy mix. Law-and-order, silent majority, EPA-era mixed government.

axes.label: Reagan-era
axes.definition: How much you want this era's policy mix. Tax cuts, anti-communism, evangelicals + free markets.

axes.label: Clinton-era
axes.definition: How much you want this era's policy mix. NAFTA, welfare reform, triangulation, Wall Street friendly.

axes.label: Bush-era
axes.definition: How much you want this era's policy mix. Iraq/Afghanistan, No Child Left Behind, Medicare Part D.

axes.label: Obama-era
axes.definition: How much you want this era's policy mix. ACA, DACA, stimulus, Iran deal, coalition foreign policy.

axes.label: Left-leaning
axes.definition: Progressive or social-democratic policy pattern (or legal-left pattern for judges).

axes.label: Right-leaning
axes.definition: Conservative or nationalist policy pattern (or legal-right pattern for judges).

axes.label: Originalism
axes.definition: Text/history as binding; cites original public meaning; rejects living-constitution.

axes.label: Living constitution
axes.definition: Constitution evolves with contemporary values; purposivism; opposite of originalism.

axes.label: Party-line
axes.definition: Rulings that track the appointing party's preferred outcome on politicized questions.

axes.label: Trump-derangement
axes.definition: 1 = treat Trump like anyone else. 5 = extra skepticism or opposition toward Trump.

axes.label: Constitutional applicability
axes.definition: Willingness to apply constitutional text as a limit on statute, agency, or emergency power.

axes.label: Gun rights
axes.definition: 2A expansion vs restriction in rulings, amicus, or public statements.

axes.label: ADL-aligned
axes.definition: Support, citation, or partnership with ADL or similar groups in rulings or public life.

axes.label: LGBTQ
axes.definition: 1 = tighten limits (sports, youth medicine, religious exemptions). 5 = expand legal recognition and protections. Not the subject's orientation.

axes.label: Cannabis
axes.definition: Legalization, decriminalization, or medical-cannabis expansion vs prohibition.

axes.label: Voter ID
axes.definition: Photo ID or proof-of-citizenship requirements to vote.

axes.label: Medical freedom
axes.definition: Oppose vaccine/mask mandates; support off-label use, informed consent, medical-choice framing.

axes.label: Remigration
axes.definition: Support for returning illegal or recently arrived migrants to origin countries; deportation-first policy.

axes.label: Abortion
axes.definition: 1 = reduce the number of abortions. 5 = increase access to abortion.

axes.label: Health insurance
axes.definition: Reduce fraud/waste vs single-payer.

axes.label: H-1B visas
axes.definition: Cut vs expand H-1B and skilled guest-worker visas.

axes.label: Border
axes.definition: Open immigration vs closed border.

axes.label: Tax direction
axes.definition: Net fiscal effect. 1 = want cuts; 5 = want raises.

axes.label: Restriction direction
axes.definition: 1 = want fewer laws/limits; 5 = want more restrictions or mandates.

axes.label: Constitutional tension
axes.definition: 1 = reject measures that conflict with or rewrite constitutional rules. 5 = accept that kind of change.

axes.label: Incumbent/class benefit
axes.definition: 1 = reject measures that advantage sitting officials, donors, or a narrow industry. 5 = accept that.
